title: Enforce the susi workflow by git: Task trailers, server-side compliance check, ruleset script
goal: Mandates 49-56 are text; git must make them binding. (1) scripts/check-workflow-compliance.sh <base> <head>: every non-merge commit needs a 'Task: T-<AGENT>-<n>' trailer naming a task that is closed (in done/) or open with a live claim ref; exempt: merge commits, 'chore: release vX.Y.Z', github-actions[bot], commits touching only .agents/tasks/. (2) .githooks/commit-msg blocks locally; pre-push runs the script on the outgoing range. (3) CI job 'Workflow Compliance' in test.yml runs it server-side on branch pushes (the part --no-verify cannot bypass). (4) scripts/github-enforce.sh prints/applies a main ruleset: PRs required, required checks incl. Workflow Compliance, no force-push/deletion, no bypass. Tests in tests/workflow_compliance.rs drive the script against real temp repos.
